description: This file defines Express route handlers for the root path '/' and a health check endpoint '/health'. It serves a simple HTML homepage indicating the server is running and provides a JSON response for health status.

methods.name: router.get '/'
methods.description: Handles GET requests to the root path '/' and responds with an HTML page indicating the server is active.

methods.name: router.get '/health'
methods.description: Handles GET requests to '/health' and responds with a JSON object indicating server health status.
